observations: Actual FileStream security-descriptor constructor confirmed available in system Windows PowerShell/.NET Framework. A new synthetic JSON file was created and removed; local observation 315 ms, not a device performance guarantee.

Actual ACL inspection proves protected DACL, one explicit current-user FullControl ACE, matching owner, despite an Everyone-inheritable-readable parent directory. Paths include Chinese, spaces, brackets and ampersand.

MCP files use the same writer; missing Windows protection rolls back principal/peer records and audit without granting a usable token. Existing exclusive-file and transaction-failure cleanup tests remain.
Successful commit, audit rollback, Git ref conflict and retry remove only their fresh index directories. Existing older commit directories and dirty checkout bytes are preserved.
Unexpected extra temporary content remains intact, returns WORKSPACE_COMMIT_CLEANUP_FAILED, and prevents delivery-manifest persistence; already generated Git objects and references remain.

initial_failure.reason: Seven paths caught a commit variable moved out of scope by the cleanup try block; two ACL inspections caught an incompatible inherited PowerShell module search path. Both corrected before final full rerun.

new_commit_ci.observed_failure: 10-second PowerShell helper timeouts; local 134-pass result does not cover the CI environment

limitations: ACL metadata was read from real Windows files, but no second real user account login was performed.
Same-user processes, administrative takeover, copied credentials, existing credentials and complete OS containment are outside this proof.
Credential output requires a trusted pre-existing local drive directory, ACL-capable filesystem and the system Windows PowerShell/.NET interface; no policy bypass or ordinary-write fallback.
Forced termination can leave a private unissued credential or temporary index directory; no automatic wildcard cleanup.
N2 authorized retention/runtime floor, M5 native configuration and N4 review documentation remain open.
